sources.title: CLEF: EEG Foundation Model for Learning Clinical Semantics
sources.snippet: We introduce CLEF, a CL inical E EG F oundation model built on two principles: long-context modeling at the scale of a full EEG session, and grounding in clinical semantics. Extending EEG foundation models from seconds to full sessions is not merely increasing context length.

sources.title: Run Fable-traces API (Easy Deployment & Flat-Rate Pricing)
sources.snippet: fable-traces is a 4 billion parameter instruction-tuned language model developed by suryatmodulus, built upon the Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 architecture. Optimized for short, conversational responses, this model is designed to run efficiently on a single mid-range GPU. It leverages bfloat16 precision and uses the ChatML prompt format, inheriting its context length from the base Qwen3 model.
